Tom / Lena - thanks again for the demo this morning. Quick recap + agreed next steps from our discovery call:

1) Decision criteria we heard
   - Security posture (SOC 2 + pen test summary)
   - Data residency & retention policy controls
   - Latency / throughput SLOs for production workloads
   - Contracting terms & procurement timeline

2) Stakeholder map (as discussed)
   - Tom Alvarez - Engineering lead / technical buyer (owns POC + perf validation)
   - Lena Ortiz - Head of Security (security evidence & compliance gate)
   - Procurement (TBD) - commercial terms, contract review
   - CFO / Economic buyer (TBD) - pricing/commit approval

3) Action items / owners
   - Redwood (Marissa): Share SOC 2 report, pen-test summary, and a sample access logs export by EOD Wed (17 Feb). (Attachment: Redwood_SOC2_report_v2.pdf, redwood-pen-test-summary.pdf, access-logs-sample.csv)
   - Finexa (Tom): Confirm procurement contact and desired contract cadence by Fri (19 Feb).
   - Finexa (Lena): Flag any additional compliance questions or evidence gaps by Fri (19 Feb).

I've attached the items we discussed and added a Drive folder link for ongoing uploads: https://drive.google.com/finexa-evidence-folder

If there's anything missing from this recap, let me know. Happy to jump on a 15-min follow-up to align stakeholders.
